svg.text: The routines go either way. Their tasks stay on Chores,
Renaming and recolouring are one request. The colour
the user picks is what propagates downstream.
Open to a user who skipped the wizard, or who deleted
A kept idea loses only its theme affiliation and stays
Nothing is deleted and nothing is changed.
Emptying both fields is how they are unset. Nothing else
The goals and routines cannot be kept, so confirming
takes them. There is no in-app undo; recovery is from
Archived goals are not counted. The count states what is
live under the theme today. Whether the prose is set is
what distinguishes a collapsed section from one never
written; the prose itself is read on expanding it.
Every form on this surface drafts as it is filled in, so
leaving it half-finished, a crash and a restart all cost
nothing. The draft is one-way: nothing waits for it to be
kept. Whichever write commits the form discards it.
One request covers the name, the colour or both. The
colour reaches every entity under the theme.
Order is relative, so a theme's place is never a stored
A goal and a routine each require a theme, so keeping
one is not a legal outcome: the gesture is then
approve-or-abandon. An idea may stay behind
theme-less, so that cascade is the one real choice and
starts off. The disclosure reaches two levels down,
because a deleted goal takes its projects and measures
with it, and so does an included idea. An archived
descendant is counted like a live one.
The only thing in the product with a default worth
seeding. BP01 seeds the same set at a first run; whether
the two call sites are one System Interaction is a Design
Both fields are optional. Empty text is the unset state.
The request carries the cascade the user approved.
What happens below a deleted goal or idea is that
entity's own rule, applied where the deletion reaches it.
